About Our School

A happy beginning to a child's learning journey.

New Cambridge Primary School (The Little Master's) is located at B51, Sainik Nagar, Mansa Ram Park, Nawada, Delhi 110059. The school focuses on the early years and primary stage, with an environment designed around learning, participation and growth.

★

Playful Learning

Making early learning engaging, active and enjoyable for young children.

♥

Child-Friendly Environment

A welcoming atmosphere that helps children feel comfortable while discovering new things.

✓

Strong Foundations

Supporting children as they develop early academic, social and creative skills.

Our Programs

Learning at every early stage.

The school's displayed programs cover nursery, pre-primary and primary classes.

EARLY YEARS

Nursery

Introducing young learners to school through playful activities and foundational learning.

PRE-PRIMARY

K.G.

Building confidence, communication, creativity and early academic readiness.

PRIMARY

1st – 5th

Developing strong learning habits and essential skills for the next stage of education.
